entities.name: Carlos López Buchardo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos Félix López Buchardo was an Argentine composer of Classical music whose work was inspired by native music. He founded the Conservatorio Nacional Superior de Música in Buenos Aires, an institution that later became a department of the current Universidad Nacional de las Artes.

entities.summary: Carlos Félix López Buchardo was an Argentine composer of Classical music whose work was inspired by native music.
